pages.text: Builds $(l)Grudge$() in combat and releases it as a shockwave. Hurts you if the shockwave kills nothing.

$(l)Core mechanics$()$(br)$(li)Dealing or taking direct damage builds $(l)Grudge$(), up to five stacks$(li)Each Grudge stack increases direct melee damage$(li)Grudge fades slowly outside combat$(li)Right Click consumes all Grudge in a soul-flame shockwave$(li)The shockwave damages, weakens, and scatters nearby enemies$(li)If the release kills nothing, you take damage
Then combine $(l)Void Ashes$(), the $(l)Tablet of Vengeance$(), the $(l)Grudgebound Idol$(), and a $(l)Nebula Ring$().
